name: Suzhousaurus
sum: Unusually large Early Cretaceous therizinosaurid from the Xinminbao Group of Gansu, China.
holotype: FRDC-GSJB-99, Xinminbao Group, Yujingzi Basin, Gansu, China.
material: Two specimens from the Xiagou and Zhonggou formations (1999, 2004).
biology: Had long claws and neck for browsing, robust hind limbs and a large trunk ending in a reduced tail; its teeth were studied for growth and replacement.
author: Li et al. 2007
